chunks: And the ruling regarding that is in another narration.
That he should mention the name of Allah at the time of eating.

key_terms.آخَرَ: another report distinct from the one previously mentioned
key_terms.حُكْمُ: the legal ruling or judgment concerning the matter
key_terms.خَبَرٍ: a narration or report used as textual evidence
key_terms.يُسَمِّيَ: to mention the name of Allah, i.e. say the tasmiyah

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on mentioning the name of Allah when eating?
ai.summary: This text states the legal ruling on the matter by referring to another hadith: one should mention the name of Allah when eating. It indicates the prescribed etiquette and ruling connected to lawful consumption.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4126 - And the ruling regarding that, as mentioned in another narration, is:
"He should mention the name of Allah (swt) at the time of eating."
